summary: Clean install and 25 real/offline tests pass, but three compiled-API probes expose missing event target correlation, successful reuse of a corrupted artifact, and a Git subdirectory retained as project root. Fix these targeted storage/identity defects before accepting L02. No UI or RPC work is requested.
findings: packages/storage/src/index.ts:357,421: createTask and claimTask by user/chief emit task_id/attempt_id/session_id null and only request_key in payload. The public event journal cannot identify the target entity. Pass target IDs and generation separately from actor identity and test task creation/claim/observations.

packages/storage/src/index.ts:1162: writeArtifact returns success for an existing regular digest file without verifying its bytes. A write, fixture corruption, and repeated write reproduce a successful reference that readArtifact immediately rejects as ARTIFACT_CHANGED. Verify existing content and fail explicitly on corruption.

packages/storage/src/project.ts:46: identifyProject from a Git subdirectory shares the repository ID but retains the subdirectory as root, which Store can persist on first opening. Resolve the Git top-level while preserving path spaces and test nested-directory startup.

checks.name: Independent strict types, format, build and 25 contract/SQLite tests
